instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Header nav has a solid background with soft border or glassmorphism (never transparent over text).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements, CTAs, product cards, cart buttons, and form inputs.
Provide mobile bottom navigation tab bar for seamless Instagram mobile traffic shopping experience.
Include a floating WhatsApp CTA button with predefined message trigger.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on wishlist/add-to-cart/coupon actions.
Support discount calculator badges (MRP strikethrough + selling price + discount % auto-calc).
Include Admin panel layout for product CRUD, inventory, combos, and orders management.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid Inter font for main headings. Use 'Playfair Display' for headlines to give Viaura an authentic boutique feel.
Maintain high contrast ratios for text on pastel backgrounds.
Never use full-screen harsh dark gradients.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all 3D and floating animations.
